note: Flavour only now: after scoring, a random critic gives a rave ('review') for a film on 10+ stamps or a 'pan' below that. The effects are no longer used for scoring; Plot comes from the genre's roles.

cards.name: Vera Plinth
cards.rule: +1 per vault legend. -1 if you have none.
cards.review: A triumph. I wept into my popcorn.
cards.pan: I wanted a legend. I got a lanyard.

cards.name: Rex Tightwad
cards.rule: -2 if any star cost $8M or more. +2 if none cost more than $5M.
cards.review: Every dollar is on screen. Sadly, so is the bill.
cards.pan: Where did all the money go? Not on screen.

cards.name: Dot Merriweather
cards.rule: +2 if three or more of your stars share a trait.
cards.review: They finish each other's sandwiches. Glorious.
cards.pan: Nobody on screen has met anybody else on screen.

cards.name: Gloria Ticketstub
cards.rule: +1 per Box Office star.
cards.review: Queues round the block. Bring a flask.
cards.pan: Half-empty on a Saturday night. Ouch.

cards.name: Sir Aubrey Fennimore-Blythe
cards.rule: +1 per Prestige star. -1 per Laughs star.
cards.review: One felt, at last, in the presence of Art.
cards.pan: A romp. I asked for Art.

cards.name: Midnight Mo
cards.rule: +1 per Cult star. -1 per Box Office star.
cards.review: Saw it nine times. Will see it ninety.
cards.pan: Too clean. Too shiny. Too popular.

cards.name: Penny Farthing
cards.rule: +1 per star you bought for $1M.
cards.review: Champagne casting on a lemonade budget.
cards.pan: Expensive and it shows. Not in a good way.

cards.name: Polly Glot
cards.rule: +1 for every different trait in your cast beyond five.
cards.review: A bit of everything, like a good buffet.
cards.pan: One flavour, all the way down.

cards.name: Barry Blockbuster
cards.rule: +2 if any star cost $10M or more.
cards.review: You can see the money. I love seeing the money.
cards.pan: Small. Timid. Cheap-looking. Yawn.

cards.name: Hester Grimm
cards.rule: +1 per Scream star.
cards.review: I slept with the lights on. Five stars.
cards.pan: Not one scream. I checked my pulse.

cards.name: Dickie Dazzle
cards.rule: +1 per Song & Dance star.
cards.review: I left humming. I'm still humming.
cards.pan: Not a single number. Not one!

cards.name: Connie Clash
cards.rule: +2 if no star carries the genre's Clash. -1 per star that does.
cards.review: Nothing jars. Everything purrs.
cards.pan: It clanks. It jars. It hurts.

cards.name: Professor Stickler
cards.rule: +1 per star matching a Want, then -2.
cards.review: Textbook. I mean that as a compliment.
cards.pan: This is not what the genre ordered.

cards.name: Lionel Lard
cards.rule: +1 per Muscle star.
cards.review: Biceps you could hang a coat on.
cards.pan: Weedy. Where are the arms?

cards.name: Agnes Weep
cards.rule: +1 per Heart star.
cards.review: Bring tissues. Bring a spare box.
cards.pan: My hankie stayed dry. Shame.

cards.name: Chuckles McGraw
cards.rule: +1 per Laughs star. -1 per Prestige star.
cards.review: I laughed so hard I missed the ending.
cards.pan: I smiled once. It was at the trailer.

cards.name: Ruby Velvet
cards.rule: +1 per Charm star.
cards.review: I'd follow this cast into a burning building.
cards.pan: Charisma vacuum. I left early.

cards.name: Edgar Razor
cards.rule: +1 per Edge star. -1 per Heart star.
cards.review: Dangerous. Unrepentant. Necessary.
cards.pan: Soft. Safe. Sentimental.

cards.name: Mabel Even-Stevens
cards.rule: +2 if every star cost between $2M and $6M.
cards.review: No egos, just teamwork. Lovely.
cards.pan: Who's the star? Everyone's arguing.

cards.name: Old Harold
cards.rule: +2 if you spent the least of any studio.
cards.review: Made for tuppence. Worth a fortune.
cards.pan: Money doesn't buy taste. Proved here.
